address: 10 Shilinsi Alley, Gusu, Suzhou, China Mainland
bio: The simple, cosy room focuses on straightforward, deftly crafted Jiangsu classics. With dad and son in the kitchen and mum in charge of the front of house, it has built a loyal fanbase over the past 30+ years thanks to warm service, good food and budget-friendly prices. The braised pork belly with vegetarian chicken in claypot is the must-try: the soy-based faux meat soaks up the drool-worthy juices of the melty pork....
